name: autogpt_platform_replica
description: AutoGPT Platform persisted port-graph reproduction. A planner compiles typed blocks and named links; the existing Subflow component schedules repeated output events, static input reuse, dynamic fan-in, bounded cycles, concurrent ready executions, editable per-block review, schema validation, cancellation and deterministic execution records while preserving Identity/EGO workers.

planner.description: Compiles requests into typed persisted port graphs

worker.description: Runs an individual graph block through its Identity/EGO harness

verifier.description: Checks terminal events and execution records

compile_graph.description: Compile a request into an AutoGPT-style named-port graph

verify_graph.description: Validate event-driven executions and terminal evidence
